statement: Dec 2007 - Apr 2011 (Venus-Venus): work and daily life were away from the home region or tied to a far-off place or foreign employer, with spending running ahead of saving
basis: Dasha lord Venus owns the 5th and 10th and sits in the 12th (worksheet sections 3, 4, 11); BPHS 24 10th lord in the 12th

statement: Apr 2011 - Apr 2012 (Venus-Sun): a sudden break or upheaval in his own position - job or role - tied to friction with a boss or other authority (or the father), hardest in the first months
basis: Sub-lord Sun owns the 8th and sits in the lagna in an enemy's sign (worksheet 2-4); Parashara names the Sun's sub-period in Venus's period among those that are bad first (kb/dashas/dasha-systems.md 1.2, BPHS ch. 52-60)

statement: Apr 2012 - Dec 2013 (Venus-Moon): a partner entered his life - a business partner in the venture or a serious relationship - and that person came from outside his own community or home region
basis: Sub-lord Moon owns the 7th, sits in the 3rd within 2 degrees of Rahu, with Mars and Jupiter; 4th from the dasha lord (supportive); strong link to the 7th in the link test (worksheet 4, 10, 11)

statement: Dec 2013 - Feb 2015 (Venus-Mars): his home base changed (a move, or a new home, property or vehicle) and earnings improved compared with the two years before
basis: Sub-lord Mars owns the 4th and 11th, sits in the 3rd in a friend's sign, second in strength by the texts; 4th from the dasha lord (supportive) (worksheet 3, 4, 9, 11)

statement: Feb 2015 - Feb 2018 (Venus-Rahu): a fresh start by his own effort in which a foreign country became central - work or a venture tied to another country, or long stays abroad - with more than one attempt before anything held
basis: Sub-lord Rahu in the 3rd, its sign-lord Jupiter owns the 3rd and 12th and sits there in own sign; Rahu with the 7th lord and the 4th/11th lord; 4th from the dasha lord (worksheet 4, 10, 11)

statement: Both younger siblings were born between Jan 1991 and Apr 1998 (his age 4 to 11), none before
basis: Sub-periods of Moon, Mars, Rahu and Jupiter in Mercury's period: all four sit in the 3rd house and carry the strong sibling link in the link test; the earlier sub-lords Ketu, Venus and Sun have none (worksheet 4, 10, 11)

statement: Dec 2000 - Dec 2007 (Ketu period, age 14 to 21): a marked setback for his father - in the father's work or money, or his health - and a distance between father and son in these years
basis: Dasha lord Ketu sits in the 9th; 9th lord Mercury below required strength; Sun, significator of the father, in an enemy's sign; 9th has 24 Ashtakavarga points (worksheet 2, 4, 9, 11) - three indications
